title: Fix missing admin panel backend methods (create list, app event, set access key, upload music)

requirements.text: Add a public Motoko backend method to create a new comment list. It must accept a list name, persist the new list in stable/mutable storage, and return a success or error result. The frontend AdminComments view must be wired to call this method so that creating a list no longer returns 'backend does not support'.

quotes: Create List — backend method missing or not wired up
they show backend does not support

acceptanceCriteria: Calling the create-list method from the admin panel stores the new list in the backend without error.
No 'backend does not support' error appears when submitting the create list form.
The newly created list appears in subsequent list fetch queries.

requirements.text: Add a public Motoko backend method to create/record an app event. It must accept the required event fields (e.g., app name, date/usernames payload), persist the event in stable storage, and return a result. The frontend AdminLiveList view must be wired to call this method so that creating an app event no longer returns 'backend does not support'.

quotes: App Event — backend doesn't support this operation
they show backend does not support

acceptanceCriteria: Calling the app event method from the admin panel stores the event without error.
No 'backend does not support' error appears when creating an app event.
Created events are retrievable from the backend in subsequent queries.

requirements.text: Add a public Motoko backend method to set and store the access key. It must accept a text key, persist it in stable/mutable state, and return a confirmation. The frontend AdminSettings view must be wired to call this method so that setting the access key no longer returns 'backend does not support'.

quotes: Set Access Key — backend method not implemented
they show backend does not support

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a new access key from AdminSettings persists it in the backend without error.
No 'backend does not support' error appears when calling set access key.
The stored access key can be retrieved and is used for subsequent key-gated operations.

requirements.text: Add a public Motoko backend method to upload and store music (URL or binary blob). It must accept the music data/URL and any relevant metadata, persist it in stable storage, and return a result. The frontend AdminSettings (background music upload) and any relevant upload views must be wired to call this method so that uploading music no longer returns 'backend does not support'.

quotes: Upload Music — backend storage/method not available
they show backend does not support

acceptanceCriteria: Uploading music from the admin panel stores the music data/URL in the backend without error.
No 'backend does not support' error appears when uploading music.
The stored music URL/data is returned by the background music settings query and plays correctly in the frontend.

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo).
Do not break or remove any existing backend methods or stored state.
Do not modify any immutable frontend paths listed in the system context.
nonGoals: Adding new frontend UI screens or redesigning the admin panel layout.
Implementing authentication beyond what already exists.
Changing any existing working admin panel features.
